source_review.reason: The opt-in observer establishes the no-workspace state from the real Settings UI and stored device selection, watches the public fixture's recognition interval for any processed_documents GET, then uses the real organization picker before requiring the scoped lookup and UI result. The exact filter checks now match the production recognition query. The branch is read-only and returns before the D23/D22 Save flow; it does not touch the private attempt checkpoint.
evidence: Before selection, the picker must show Choose… and no stored organization. The listener is attached before navigating to the exact public fixture and opening Scrape; the settled UI must show choose-workspace unknown, and any processed_documents GET in this interval fails the branch, including one with an organization filter.

After selection through chooseOrganization, the observer requires at least one completed exact GET whose canonical_identity equals the fixture's canonical URL, organization_id equals the selected stored ID, origin_client is eq.extension, derivation_kind is in.(initial_extract,recapture), and deleted_at is is.null.

The observer only returns none when every observed exact request completed with HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array; zero requests, pending/failed responses, malformed bodies, mixed none/found results, or any nonempty response remain null/unknown or fail closed. Repeated identical reads are permitted, but every one must be empty/200.

After the scoped response, the active Scrape UI must show notSaved with no saved banner, checkUnknown, or Source link. The branch issues no Capture/Save input and bypasses existingSaveAttempt/reserveSaveAttempt entirely; only an exclusive private diagnostic screenshot may be created on failure.

Production lookupCapturedByUrl uses the same .eq(canonical_identity), .eq(origin_client, 'extension'), .eq(organization_id), .in(derivation_kind, ['initial_extract','recapture']), and .is(deleted_at, null) filters.
